EMBER BED WIDE POOL: a hot low bed of embers throwing a wide shallow pool of deep orange across everything within its reach, every nearest surface giving up its grain and its cracked texture in amber, small soft shadows pooling behind each raised edge

EMBER WASH LOW: embers holding a broad orange wash close to the ground, the surfaces it touches reading their moss and their ridged grain clearly, small shadows tucked behind every small thing, the warmth thinning into cool blue well before the far edge

EMBER GLOW SPREAD: a low hot bed of embers spreading a wide pool of orange warmth outward, whatever stands closest showing its cracked face and its colour under the dust, long soft shadows drawn back behind each standing thing

EMBER ORANGE SHALLOW: a shallow orange glow rolling out from a low bed of embers, the ground beneath it reading its texture and its damp shine clearly, small shadows blooming behind every small raised thing at its edge

EMBER DEEP POOL: a deep orange ember pool spreading slow and wide, the nearest surfaces lit so the grain and the wet shine in every hollow show plainly, soft shadows stretching back from whatever stands within its reach

TALL FLAME AMBER: a tall bright flame throwing a high wide amber glow with restless edges, whatever stands nearest lit warm along every ridge and seam, the surrounding shapes holding their form in soft dim blue beyond

BRIGHT FLAME REACH: a tall flame sending a wide amber glow outward with moving edges, the surfaces it touches bright enough to show their weave and their cracked colour, everything beyond settling into quiet blue-grey

FLAME HIGH WIDE: a tall bright flame pushing its amber glow high and wide, every nearest surface catching warm light along its raised edges and showing the grain beneath, the glow restless and reaching as the flame lifts

TALL FLAME RESTLESS: a tall bright flame with a wide restless amber glow, the nearest surfaces reading their ridged texture and their damp undercolour in the warm light, soft shadows swinging slowly as the flame shifts

HUNG LANTERN STEADY: one hung lantern holding a small steady halo of warm gold, whatever stands closest lit clearly along its edges with its grain and its moss visible, the warmth falling away quickly into soft blue beyond

LANTERN HALO CLOSE: one lantern casting a small warm halo, the nearest surfaces showing their weave and their cracked texture in clear gold light, everything a short step beyond fading into dim blue that still holds its shape

HUNG LANTERN GOLD: a single hung lantern holding its halo steady, whatever stands within its reach reading its ridged edges and its wet shine in warm gold, the ground beneath it showing its colour and its grain before the light gives way

LANTERN WARM FALL: one small lantern throwing a tight warm halo, the surfaces it touches lit so their texture and their colour under the dust come plainly forward, the warmth thinning fast beyond into cool soft grey

WATER SCATTER FLECKS: warm light scattered across the surface in a bright spread of shifting flecks, every fleck picking out a small wet shine and a rippled ridge, the surrounding surface settling into dark blue that still holds its gentle shape

BRIGHT FLECK SPREAD: a spread of bright warm flecks rolling across the nearest surface, each one catching a wet edge and a small raised ridge in amber, the broader surface reading its gentle texture in the spaces between

FLECK SCATTER WARM: warm light broken into a scatter of bright flecks across the surface, each fleck pulling a small wet shine and a ripple edge into amber, the wider surface holding its dim blue shape beyond the scatter

HIGH LAMP FAN SLOW: a lamp held high spreading a soft warm fan slowly outward and thinning, the ground beneath it reading its texture and its grain clearly at the centre, the warmth spreading to a faint warm edge before the dim blue takes over

SOFT FAN OUTWARD: a soft warm fan of light spreading from a high lamp, whatever is nearest lit with its cracked surface and its moss showing, the fan thinning steadily outward until only a warm tint remains against the blue-grey

LAMP HIGH SPREAD: a lamp high above spreading a soft fan of warm light slowly across whatever lies beneath it, the nearest surfaces showing their grain and their damp shine, the fan losing its warmth gradually into the surrounding dim

STRING SEPARATE HALOS: a string of small lights each holding its own separate warm halo, the surfaces beneath each one reading their texture and their ridge clearly in gold, cooler dim ground lying between each halo in soft blue-grey

SMALL LIGHTS STRING: small lights strung at intervals each making its own tight halo, whatever stands nearest each one lit along its grain and its cracked edge in warm gold, the ground between each pool reading its shape in cool dim blue

SPACED LANTERN HALOS: several small lanterns spaced well apart, each casting its own separate warm halo with its own lit ground showing grain and moss, the gaps between them holding a soft cool blue that still carries the shapes of whatever stands there

WALL RETURN WARM: a fire set against a surface throwing its warmth back across everything nearest, the returned glow pulling out long soft shadows behind each standing thing and lighting weave and grain on the surfaces that face it

OVERHANG BOUNCE GLOW: a fire below an overhang bouncing its amber warmth back and down, the nearest surfaces reading their cracked texture and their colour under the dust in the doubled warmth, long soft shadows stretching away behind whatever stands close

FIRE WALL PULL: a fire against a close surface returning its glow outward, the warm light picking out grain and wet shine on everything nearest and pulling long gentle shadows back behind each small raised thing, the surrounding ground holding soft cool shape beyond
